reason: Conversation 2 opens with the unplug-first safety step, asks targeted questions (hose coin test, wand check), and goes straight to the correct cause (never-washed filters) in few turns. Conversation 1 is long and misdescribes the filter locations (top of bin lid and rear near the power cord, rather than under the bin), says 'cold water' while making inaccurate claims such as '90% of the time' and 'extended the life of your motor', and never tells the user to unplug before the checks. It also suggests unnecessary extras such as a reset and replacing filters, and it makes the user come back to say they found the filters under the bin. Both reach the right outcome with no part needed, but Conversation 2 is safer and more efficient and less padded with inaccuracies.
